title: Sahara Desert Adventure
subtitle: From Fez
intro: Experience the magic of the Sahara Desert with a multi-day tour from Fez that takes you through stunning landscapes, historic towns, and unforgettable desert adventures. From camel trekking to sleeping under a blanket of stars in a luxury desert camp, this journey offers an unparalleled opportunity to explore the heart of Morocco’s natural and cultural wonders.

itinerary.title: Departure from Fez and Journey Through the Middle Atlas
itinerary.body: Your adventure begins with a scenic drive through the Middle Atlas Mountains. Pass through the charming town of Ifrane, known for its alpine-style architecture, and visit the lush cedar forests of Azrou, home to playful Barbary macaques. Enjoy a traditional Moroccan lunch in Midelt before continuing through the Ziz Valley with its stunning palm groves. Conclude your day with an overnight stay in Erfoud or Merzouga, where you’ll prepare for your desert experience.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Desert and Camel Trekking
itinerary.body: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before heading into the desert. Visit the lively Rissani market to experience local culture and shop for unique crafts. Embark on an unforgettable camel trek through the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi, arriving at a luxury desert camp. End your day with a traditional Moroccan dinner under the stars, accompanied by local music and stories around a campfire.

itinerary.title: Sunrise in the Desert and Return to Fez
itinerary.body: Wake early to witness a breathtaking sunrise over the dunes, a moment of serene beauty. Enjoy breakfast at the camp before beginning your journey back to Fez. Along the way, take in the diverse landscapes and make scenic stops for photos and memories. Arrive back at your accommodation in Fez by evening, bringing your adventure to a close.

source: fez/Embark on a Sahara Desert Adventure.docx

title: Desert Adventure
subtitle: From Fez to Marrakech via the Sahara
intro: Embark on an unforgettable 4-day journey through Morocco’s most stunning landscapes, traveling from Fez to Marrakech. This tour takes you through the enchanting Middle Atlas Mountains, the golden sands of the Sahara Desert, and the dramatic High Atlas Mountains. Along the way, experience camel trekking, explore ancient kasbahs, and immerse yourself in the vibrant culture of Morocco’s Berber communities.

itinerary.title: Fez to Merzouga
itinerary.body: Start your journey with a scenic drive through the Middle Atlas Mountains. Pass through the charming town of Ifrane, often called the "Little Switzerland" of Morocco, and visit the cedar forests of Azrou, home to playful Barbary macaques. Continue south to Midelt for a traditional Moroccan lunch. As you descend toward the Sahara, marvel at the lush Ziz Valley, dotted with palm groves. Arrive in Merzouga, where you’ll settle into a desert hotel for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Merzouga and Camel Trekking
itinerary.body: Begin your day with breakfast before exploring the area around Merzouga. Visit local Berber villages, learn about the nomadic lifestyle, and experience the vibrant Rissani market. In the afternoon, embark on a camel trek into the desert, traversing the mesmerizing dunes of Erg Chebbi. Reach your luxury desert camp in time for a stunning sunset. Enjoy a traditional Moroccan dinner under the stars, accompanied by music and stories by the campfire.

itinerary.title: Merzouga to Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: Wake early to witness the magical sunrise over the dunes before returning to Merzouga by camel. After breakfast, travel through the dramatic Todra Gorge, where towering cliffs create a spectacular canyon. Stop for lunch in a nearby village before continuing to the Dades Valley, known for its lush landscapes and ancient kasbahs. Arrive in Ouarzazate, the "Hollywood of Morocco," where you’ll spend the night in a comfortable riad.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
itinerary.body: On the final day of your journey, explore the historic Aït Benhaddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site and iconic filming location. Walk through the fortified village and learn about its history and significance. Continue your journey through the High Atlas Mountains, crossing the stunning Tizi n'Tichka Pass. Arrive in Marrakech by evening, where you’ll be dropped off at your accommodation, marking the end of an incredible adventure.

title: Marrakech City and Surroundings Discovery Tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Arrive in Marrakech, where your guide will welcome you and transfer you to a traditional riad. Begin your adventure with an afternoon visit to Jemaa el-Fnaa square, the heart of the city, buzzing with storytellers, snake charmers, and musicians. Explore the Koutoubia Mosque, an iconic symbol of Marrakech, before enjoying a rooftop dinner overlooking the Medina.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Spend the day uncovering Marrakech’s treasures. Start with a visit to the Majorelle Garden, a serene retreat of exotic plants and cobalt blue designs. Continue to the Bahia Palace, a masterpiece of Moroccan architecture with ornate tilework and tranquil courtyards. After lunch at a local restaurant, explore the vibrant souks, where artisans sell spices, carpets, and jewelry. End the day with a traditional Moroccan hammam experience to relax and rejuvenate.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to the Atlas Mountains
itinerary.body: Embark on a day trip to the High Atlas Mountains, just an hour from Marrakech. Visit the picturesque Ourika Valley, where Berber villages cling to the mountainsides. Enjoy a guided hike to Setti Fatma waterfalls or relax in a riverside café. Savor a traditional Berber lunch at a family home before returning to Marrakech. Spend your evening at leisure, perhaps revisiting the Medina.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Use your final morning to explore any sites you may have missed, such as the Saadian Tombs or the Dar Si Said Museum. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before transferring to the airport, taking with you memories of Marrakech’s vibrant culture and hospitality.

source: Marrakech/Marrakech City and Surroundings Discovery Tour (4 Days, 3 Nights).docx

title: Imperial Cities Tour
subtitle: Explore Morocco’s Historic Capitals from Fez
intro: Embark on a captivating 5-day journey through Morocco’s imperial cities, starting in Fez. This tour offers an immersive experience of the country’s cultural heritage, taking you through Fez, Meknes, Rabat, and Casablanca. Discover ancient medinas, majestic palaces, and vibrant souks as you delve into the history and charm of Morocco’s historic capitals.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Fez
itinerary.body: Begin your adventure in Fez, Morocco’s spiritual and cultural heart. Check into your riad and explore the vibrant Medina, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Visit the Al-Qarawiyyin Mosque, Bou Inania Madrasa, and the traditional tanneries. Enjoy an authentic Moroccan dinner before settling in for the night.

itinerary.title: Fez to Meknes and Volubilis
itinerary.body: Travel to Meknes, known for its grand architecture and imperial history. Visit Bab Mansour, the Royal Stables, and the Moulay Ismail Mausoleum. Continue to the ancient Roman ruins of Volubilis, a UNESCO World Heritage site, where you can explore well-preserved mosaics and ruins. Overnight in Meknes.

itinerary.title: Meknes to Rabat
itinerary.body: Journey to Rabat, Morocco’s modern capital. Explore the Royal Palace, Hassan Tower, and the Oudayas Kasbah. Stroll along the coastal promenade and enjoy a relaxing evening in this elegant city. Spend the night in a boutique riad.

itinerary.title: Rabat to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Head to Casablanca, Morocco’s largest city. Visit the stunning Hassan II Mosque, an architectural masterpiece overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. Take a stroll through the city’s modern districts and enjoy a leisurely evening in this cosmopolitan hub. Overnight in Casablanca.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Conclude your journey with a transfer to Casablanca’s Mohammed V International Airport or return to Fez, depending on your travel plans. Take home cherished memories of Morocco’s imperial cities.

title: Marrakech and Desert Adventure

itinerary.title: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Welcome to Marrakech! Upon arrival, you’ll be greeted by your guide and transferred to your charming riad in the heart of the Medina. After settling in, embark on a guided evening tour of Jemaa el-Fnaa square, the vibrant epicenter of Marrakech. Here, snake charmers, storytellers, and musicians fill the air with energy and excitement. Explore the surrounding souks, where stalls overflow with colorful textiles, fragrant spices, and intricate handicrafts. For dinner, indulge in a traditional Moroccan feast at a renowned restaurant, sampling iconic dishes like chicken tagine with preserved lemons and sweet pastilla. End your evening with mint tea on your riad’s rooftop terrace, enjoying the sounds of the city.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Dive into Marrakech’s cultural treasures with a full-day guided tour. Begin at the Majorelle Garden, a serene oasis of exotic plants and vivid cobalt-blue architecture, once owned by Yves Saint Laurent. Visit the adjacent Yves Saint Laurent Museum to explore the designer’s creative legacy. Next, step back in time at the Bahia Palace, a 19th-century masterpiece with ornate carvings, tranquil courtyards, and lush gardens. Continue to the Saadian Tombs, hidden for centuries and now a testament to Morocco’s rich history. After lunch at a traditional courtyard café, take a leisurely carriage ride around the ancient Medina walls, enjoying the city’s vibrant energy. Conclude your day with a sunset stroll and dinner in Jemaa el-Fnaa square, surrounded by the mesmerizing atmosphere of Marrakech by night.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Merzouga (Sahara Desert)
itinerary.body: Start your desert adventure with a scenic drive across the Tizi n’Tichka pass, the gateway to the High Atlas Mountains. Stop at Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and explore its iconic kasbah, a stunning example of traditional earthen architecture. Continue through the Dades Valley, known as the “Valley of a Thousand Kasbahs,” where lush greenery contrasts with rugged cliffs. Pause at the dramatic Todra Gorge for a short hike amidst towering canyon walls. Arrive in Merzouga by late afternoon and embark on a camel trek across the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi. Your journey ends at a luxury desert camp, where a warm welcome awaits. Enjoy a starlit dinner featuring traditional Berber dishes, followed by an evening of live music and storytelling around the campfire.

itinerary.title: Full Day in the Sahara Desert
itinerary.body: Awake to the breathtaking sight of the sunrise painting the dunes in shades of gold and crimson. After a hearty breakfast, set out to explore the Sahara’s unique landscape. Visit a nearby nomadic village to learn about the traditions and daily life of desert communities. For adventure seekers, try sandboarding down the dunes or quad biking across the sandy expanse. Return to your camp for a leisurely lunch and spend the afternoon relaxing in the tranquil desert setting. As night falls, gather around the campfire for a magical evening of storytelling and stargazing, where the unpolluted skies reveal constellations in dazzling clarity.

itinerary.title: Return to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Bid farewell to the Sahara as you begin your journey back to Marrakech. Along the way, take breaks to enjoy scenic vistas of the Atlas Mountains and traditional Berber villages. Stop for lunch in Ouarzazate, often called the “Hollywood of Morocco,” before continuing your drive. Arrive in Marrakech by evening, where your adventure concludes with a farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant. Reflect on the incredible memories of your desert journey as you savor the flavors of Moroccan cuisine one last time.

source: Marrakech/Marrakech and Desert Adventure (5 Days, 4 Nights).docx

title: Sahara Desert Adventure
subtitle: From Fez to Marrakech
intro: Immerse yourself in the wonders of Morocco with this 5-day journey through the Sahara Desert, taking you from Fez to Marrakech. Explore lush valleys, dramatic gorges, ancient kasbahs, and golden dunes while experiencing authentic Moroccan hospitality. This adventure offers a perfect blend of culture, nature, and unforgettable moments in the heart of Morocco.

itinerary.title: Fez to Midelt
itinerary.body: Begin your journey with a scenic drive through the Middle Atlas Mountains. Visit the alpine-inspired town of Ifrane, known as the "Little Switzerland" of Morocco, and the cedar forests of Azrou, where you can spot playful Barbary macaques. Stop for lunch in Midelt, a tranquil town surrounded by stunning mountain landscapes. Enjoy an overnight stay in Midelt, where you can relax and prepare for your desert journey.

itinerary.title: Midelt to Merzouga
itinerary.body: After breakfast, continue south, passing through the dramatic Ziz Valley with its lush palm groves and fortified villages. Arrive in Merzouga, the gateway to the Sahara Desert, by afternoon. Explore the nearby villages and learn about local Berber culture. In the evening, enjoy a camel trek into the dunes of Erg Chebbi. Spend the night in a luxury desert camp, savoring traditional Moroccan cuisine under a blanket of stars.

itinerary.title: Merzouga to Todra Gorge
itinerary.body: Wake up early to watch a breathtaking sunrise over the dunes before returning to Merzouga by camel. After breakfast, journey to the Todra Gorge, a spectacular canyon with towering cliffs. Take a leisurely walk along the river and marvel at the natural beauty. Spend the night in a comfortable riad near the gorge, enjoying delicious local dishes and the tranquility of this stunning region.

itinerary.title: Todra Gorge to Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: After breakfast, travel through the scenic Dades Valley, known for its "Road of a Thousand Kasbahs." Visit ancient kasbahs and picturesque Berber villages. Stop at the iconic Rose Valley, famous for its fragrant rose products, before arriving in Ouarzazate. Explore this cinematic city, including a visit to the Atlas Film Studios or the Taourirt Kasbah. Spend the night in a traditional riad in Ouarzazate.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Conclude your journey with a visit to the legendary Aït Benhaddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site and filming location for many iconic movies. Walk through the fortified village and learn about its history. Continue through the High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi n'Tichka Pass, enjoying panoramic views and scenic stops along the way. Arrive in Marrakech by evening, marking the end of your unforgettable desert adventure.

title: Desert and Atlas Mountain Adventure
subtitle: Fez to Marrakech
intro: Dive into the wonders of Morocco on a 6-day journey through the Sahara Desert and the majestic Atlas Mountains. From camel trekking in the golden dunes to exploring historic kasbahs and meeting Berber communities, this tour combines nature, culture, and adventure. Starting in Fez and ending in Marrakech, every day is filled with unforgettable experiences.

itinerary.title: Fez to Erfoud
itinerary.body: Begin your journey with a drive through the Middle Atlas Mountains. Visit the picturesque town of Ifrane, often called "Little Switzerland," and the cedar forests of Azrou, home to playful Barbary macaques. Stop for a traditional lunch in Midelt before descending into the Ziz Valley. Arrive in Erfoud, known as the gateway to the desert, where you’ll spend the night in a comfortable hotel.

itinerary.title: Erfoud to Merzouga
itinerary.body: After breakfast, explore the local fossil workshops in Erfoud, famous for their ancient discoveries. Continue to Merzouga, where the Sahara Desert awaits. Visit nearby nomadic Berber communities and learn about their way of life. In the afternoon, embark on a camel trek through the mesmerizing dunes of Erg Chebbi. Arrive at your luxury desert camp in time for sunset and enjoy a traditional dinner under the stars, complete with music and storytelling.

itinerary.title: Merzouga to Todra Gorge
itinerary.body: Wake early to witness a stunning desert sunrise before returning to Merzouga by camel. After breakfast, head toward the Todra Gorge, stopping along the way to explore local villages and palm oases. The towering cliffs of the Todra Gorge provide a breathtaking backdrop for a leisurely walk along the river. Spend the night in a cozy riad near the gorge.

itinerary.title: Todra Gorge to Dades Valley
itinerary.body: Begin your day with a drive through the scenic Dades Valley, known for its dramatic rock formations and traditional kasbahs. Stop at the "Monkey Fingers" rock formation and enjoy a guided walk to appreciate the natural beauty of the valley. Visit local Berber communities and learn about their traditions. Spend the night in a charming riad overlooking the valley.

itinerary.title: Dades Valley to Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: Continue your journey through the Rose Valley, famous for its fragrant rose products and annual festival. Visit Skoura, home to the iconic Amridil Kasbah, and learn about its historical significance. Arrive in Ouarzazate, known as the "Hollywood of Morocco," where you can explore the Atlas Film Studios or the Taourirt Kasbah. Relax at a traditional riad for the night.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Conclude your adventure with a visit to the legendary Aït Benhaddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site and filming location for many famous movies. Walk through the fortified village and immerse yourself in its history. Cross the High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi n'Tichka Pass, enjoying panoramic views and scenic stops along the way. Arrive in Marrakech by evening, where your journey comes to an end.

title: Marrakech and Coastal Escape

itinerary.title: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Your journey begins with your arrival in the enchanting city of Marrakech. A private transfer will take you to a charming riad nestled in the heart of the Medina. Take some time to relax and soak in the serene ambiance of traditional Moroccan hospitality. As evening falls, head to Jemaa el-Fnaa square, where a vibrant display of street performers, musicians, and food stalls brings the city to life. Savor a delicious rooftop dinner overlooking the illuminated Medina, with the scent of spices and sounds of the city providing the perfect welcome to your adventure.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Discover Marrakech’s rich history and culture with a guided tour of its most iconic landmarks. Begin at the Bahia Palace, a stunning 19th-century masterpiece adorned with intricate mosaics and tranquil gardens. Continue to the Majorelle Garden, a lush sanctuary filled with exotic plants and vibrant cobalt blue architecture. Visit the Koutoubia Mosque, the city’s spiritual heart and a symbol of its Islamic heritage. After a traditional lunch, explore the labyrinthine souks, where artisans craft everything from leather goods to handwoven carpets. Conclude your day with a soothing hammam experience, leaving you relaxed and rejuvenated.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Essaouira
itinerary.body: Set off for the coastal town of Essaouira, a charming UNESCO World Heritage site. Along the way, stop at an argan oil cooperative to learn about the production process and pick up authentic products. Upon arrival in Essaouira, wander through its picturesque Medina, known for its whitewashed walls and vibrant blue doors. Explore the Skala fortress, where panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean await. Indulge in a seafood lunch at the bustling port, savoring the freshest catch of the day. Spend your afternoon relaxing on the sandy beach before settling into a cozy riad for the night.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Essaouira
itinerary.body: Immerse yourself in Essaouira’s laid-back charm. Start your day with a leisurely camel ride along the beach, soaking in the refreshing sea breeze. Explore local art galleries showcasing contemporary and traditional Moroccan art, or visit the souks to browse unique handicrafts. For a taste of the region’s specialty, tour an argan oil cooperative and learn about its cultural and economic importance. Enjoy a relaxed evening with a waterfront dinner as the sun sets over the Atlantic, reflecting the town’s serene beauty.

itinerary.title: Essaouira to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Return to Marrakech, stopping at scenic viewpoints along the way. Upon arrival, enjoy free time to revisit your favorite parts of the Medina, shop for last-minute souvenirs, or simply relax at your riad. In the evening, celebrate the end of your journey with a farewell dinner at a traditional Moroccan restaurant. Live music and storytelling will make this final night unforgettable.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: After a leisurely breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure. Leave with cherished memories of Marrakech’s vibrant culture and Essaouira’s coastal serenity, a perfect blend of city energy and seaside tranquility.

source: Marrakech/Marrakech and Coastal Escape (6 Days, 5 Nights).docx

title: Marrakech Culture and Wellness Retreat

itinerary.title: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Arrive in Marrakech, where you’ll be welcomed with a private transfer to a serene boutique riad in the Medina. After settling in, take a leisurely evening stroll through Jemaa el-Fnaa square, soaking in the vibrant energy of street performers and market vendors. End your day with a relaxing dinner in a peaceful courtyard restaurant, sampling dishes like lamb tagine with apricots and mint tea.

itinerary.title: Discover the Soul of Marrakech
itinerary.body: Begin your day with a guided tour of Marrakech’s cultural landmarks. Explore the Bahia Palace, a 19th-century gem with intricate carvings and lush gardens. Continue to the Saadian Tombs, where centuries of Moroccan history come to life. After lunch, enjoy a curated shopping experience in the souks, guided by a local expert who will take you to the best spots for textiles, spices, and pottery. Unwind in the evening with a private hammam experience, followed by a traditional dinner served under lantern-lit skies.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to the Agafay Desert
itinerary.body: Escape the bustle of the city with a day trip to the Agafay Desert, a stone desert just outside Marrakech. Relax in a luxurious desert lodge where you can swim in an infinity pool overlooking the arid landscape. Enjoy camel rides, quad biking, or simply savor the tranquility. A gourmet picnic lunch will be served in a Berber-style tent. Return to Marrakech for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Gardens and Wellness
itinerary.body: Immerse yourself in Marrakech’s green sanctuaries with visits to the Majorelle Garden and the nearby Anima Garden. Stroll through these lush, artistic havens and learn about their history and connection to Morocco’s botanical heritage. Afterward, enjoy a Moroccan cooking class, where you’ll learn to prepare classic dishes like zaalouk and Moroccan pancakes. Conclude your day with a sunset yoga session in the riad’s garden, promoting relaxation and mindfulness.

itinerary.title: Free Day to Explore
itinerary.body: Spend your final full day exploring Marrakech at your own pace. Options include visiting the Museum of Marrakech, taking a horse-drawn carriage ride around the Medina walls, or indulging in a spa treatment at a luxury hotel. In the evening, enjoy a farewell dinner with live Moroccan music and storytelling.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before your private transfer to the airport. Depart Marrakech feeling refreshed and enriched by its culture, cuisine, and beauty.

source: Marrakech/Marrakech Culture and Wellness Retreat (6 Days, 5 Nights).docx

itinerary.title: Casablanca to El Jadida
itinerary.body: Your adventure begins with a morning departure from Casablanca to the coastal town of El Jadida. Known for its Portuguese heritage, this UNESCO World Heritage site offers a unique blend of Moroccan and European influences. Start with a guided tour of the Portuguese Cisterns, a striking underground structure with Gothic architecture and an enchanting reflective pool. Stroll through the fortified Medina, where cobblestone streets lead to quaint shops and cafes. Enjoy a fresh seafood lunch overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. In the afternoon, relax on El Jadida’s sandy beaches before settling into your boutique hotel for the evening.

itinerary.title: El Jadida to Essaouira
itinerary.body: Travel along Morocco’s scenic Atlantic coastline to the charming seaside town of Essaouira. Stop en route at Oualidia, a picturesque fishing village famous for its oyster farms. Arrive in Essaouira by midday, where you’ll check into a riad within the Medina. Spend the afternoon exploring the town’s historic ramparts, the bustling port, and artisan shops showcasing woodwork and silver jewelry. In the evening, savor a dinner of freshly caught seafood at a local restaurant.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Essaouira
itinerary.body: Wake up to the sounds of seagulls and ocean waves in Essaouira. Start your day with a guided tour of the Medina, a UNESCO World Heritage site, with its narrow alleys, whitewashed buildings, and vibrant blue doors. Visit the Skala fortress for panoramic views of the coastline. For a hands-on experience, learn about argan oil production at a local cooperative. In the afternoon, take a camel ride along the beach or relax in a beachfront café. End your day with a magical sunset and a traditional Moroccan dinner in the Medina.

itinerary.title: Essaouira to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Depart Essaouira for Marrakech, stopping along the way at Berber villages to interact with locals. Arrive in Marrakech by early afternoon and check into your riad. Begin exploring the city with a visit to the vibrant Jemaa el-Fnaa square, where snake charmers, musicians, and food stalls create a lively atmosphere. Enjoy a rooftop dinner overlooking the bustling square before retiring for the night.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Spend the day discovering Marrakech’s treasures. Visit the Majorelle Garden, a serene retreat filled with exotic plants and vibrant colors. Continue to the Bahia Palace, a stunning example of Moroccan architecture with intricate tilework and peaceful courtyards. After lunch, explore the souks, where you can shop for spices, textiles, and ceramics. Conclude your day with a hammam experience, relaxing in traditional Moroccan style.

itinerary.title: Return to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Bid farewell to Marrakech as you journey back to Casablanca. En route, stop at Morocco Mall for shopping or visit the Ain Diab Corniche for a leisurely stroll. End your tour with a farewell dinner by the Atlantic Ocean, reflecting on your coastal adventure.

title: Cultural Immersion Tour
subtitle: Journey into Morocco’s Traditions and Heritage
intro: Experience Morocco like never before with this 7-day Cultural Immersion Tour, designed to connect you deeply with the country’s vibrant traditions, diverse landscapes, and warm hospitality. From hands-on workshops and authentic meals to exploring Berber villages and historic cities, this journey will leave you enriched and inspired.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Fez
itinerary.body: Arrive in Fez, the cultural capital of Morocco. Settle into your riad and enjoy a welcome dinner featuring authentic Moroccan cuisine. Spend the evening soaking in the charm of the ancient Medina.

itinerary.title: Explore Fez and Traditional Workshops
itinerary.body: Dive into Fez’s rich heritage with a guided tour of the Medina. Visit artisanal workshops where you’ll learn about traditional crafts such as pottery, leatherworking, and tile making. Spend the afternoon participating in a hands-on pottery workshop to create your own Moroccan masterpiece.

itinerary.title: Fez to Chefchaouen
itinerary.body: Travel to Chefchaouen, the iconic blue city nestled in the Rif Mountains. Explore its serene streets, interact with local artisans, and enjoy a relaxed evening in this picturesque town.

itinerary.title: Cooking Class and Village Visit
itinerary.body: Return to Fez and immerse yourself in Moroccan culinary traditions with a cooking class. Learn to prepare dishes such as tagine, couscous, and traditional Moroccan salads. In the afternoon, visit a nearby Berber village to meet local families and learn about their way of life.

itinerary.title: Fez to the Middle Atlas Mountains
itinerary.body: Head to the Middle Atlas Mountains for a day of breathtaking scenery and cultural discovery. Visit the town of Ifrane, known as "Little Switzerland," and the cedar forests of Azrou. Enjoy a traditional lunch with a Berber family and learn about their customs.

itinerary.title: Explore Volubilis and Meknes
itinerary.body: Travel to the ancient Roman city of Volubilis to explore its well-preserved ruins. Continue to Meknes, where you’ll visit its grand gates, mausoleums, and lively souks. Return to Fez for your final night in the city.

itinerary.title: Departure from Fez
itinerary.body: Conclude your journey with a farewell breakfast before transferring to the airport. Take home cherished memories and a deeper understanding of Moroccan culture.

title: Grand Desert Expedition
subtitle: From Fez to Marrakech
intro: Embark on a 7-day journey through Morocco’s most captivating landscapes, from the Middle Atlas Mountains to the vast Sahara Desert and the iconic High Atlas Mountains. This extended adventure offers ample time to immerse yourself in Morocco’s rich culture, explore ancient kasbahs, and enjoy unique experiences like camel trekking and meeting local Berber communities.

itinerary.title: Fez to Ifrane and Midelt
itinerary.body: Start your journey with a drive through the Middle Atlas Mountains. Visit Ifrane, known as "Little Switzerland," and the cedar forests of Azrou, where you may encounter Barbary macaques. Stop for lunch in Midelt, a tranquil town surrounded by stunning mountain scenery. Spend the night in a cozy hotel in Midelt.

itinerary.title: Midelt to Erfoud and Merzouga
itinerary.body: Continue your journey south through the dramatic Ziz Valley, famous for its lush palm groves. Arrive in Erfoud, renowned for its fossil workshops, and continue to Merzouga. In the evening, enjoy a relaxing dinner and stay in a comfortable riad near the desert.

itinerary.title: Merzouga and Erg Chebbi Dunes
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring the desert landscapes around Merzouga. Visit the Khamlia village, home to Gnaoua musicians, and learn about their rich traditions. Later, embark on a camel trek into the Erg Chebbi dunes, arriving at a luxury desert camp for a magical night under the stars with traditional music and delicious Moroccan cuisine.

itinerary.title: Merzouga to Todra Gorge
itinerary.body: Witness a breathtaking sunrise over the dunes before returning to Merzouga by camel. After breakfast, travel to the Todra Gorge, a spectacular canyon with towering cliffs. Enjoy a guided walk along the river and take in the natural beauty of this serene area. Spend the night in a charming riad near the gorge.

itinerary.title: Todra Gorge to Dades Valley and Skoura
itinerary.body: Journey through the Dades Valley, known for its unique rock formations and ancient kasbahs. Stop at the "Monkey Fingers" rock formation and take a short hike to explore the surrounding landscapes. Continue to Skoura, a picturesque oasis dotted with palm groves and historic kasbahs. Spend the night in a traditional riad in Skoura.

itinerary.title: Skoura to Ouarzazate and Aït Benhaddou
itinerary.body: Visit the iconic Amridil Kasbah in Skoura before heading to Ouarzazate, the "Hollywood of Morocco." Explore the Taourirt Kasbah and visit the Atlas Film Studios. Later, discover the UNESCO-listed Aït Benhaddou, a fortified village and filming location for many famous movies. Spend the night in a riad near Aït Benhaddou.

itinerary.title: Aït Benhaddou to Marrakech via High Atlas Mountains
itinerary.body: Conclude your journey with a drive through the High Atlas Mountains, crossing the Tizi n'Tichka Pass. Enjoy stunning views, scenic stops, and traditional Berber villages along the way. Arrive in Marrakech by evening, where your adventure ends with drop-off at your accommodation.

title: Imperial Cities Tour
subtitle: Explore Morocco’s Historic Capitals from Fez
intro: Embark on a week-long journey through Morocco’s imperial cities, starting in Fez. This 7-day tour provides a rich cultural experience, taking you to the historic cities of Meknes, Rabat, Casablanca, and Marrakech. Discover ancient medinas, majestic palaces, and vibrant souks while uncovering the fascinating history of Morocco’s most iconic capitals.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Fez
itinerary.body: Start your adventure in Fez, Morocco’s spiritual and cultural heart. Settle into your riad and explore the Medina, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Visit the Al-Qarawiyyin Mosque, Bou Inania Madrasa, and the bustling tanneries. Enjoy an authentic Moroccan dinner and rest for the night.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Fez Exploration
itinerary.body: Dive deeper into Fez’s historic wonders. Wander the narrow streets of the Medina, shop in the vibrant souks, and visit the Mellah (Jewish Quarter). Explore artisanal workshops and learn about Fez’s rich crafts heritage. Spend the night in your riad.

itinerary.title: Fez to Meknes and Volubilis
itinerary.body: Travel to Meknes, known for its grand gates and imperial history. Visit Bab Mansour, the Royal Stables, and the Moulay Ismail Mausoleum. Continue to Volubilis, a UNESCO-listed Roman site, to admire its mosaics and ruins. Return to Meknes for an overnight stay in a charming riad.

itinerary.title: Meknes to Rabat
itinerary.body: Journey to Rabat, Morocco’s modern capital. Explore the Royal Palace, Hassan Tower, and the Oudayas Kasbah. Stroll along the city’s coastal promenade and enjoy a relaxing evening in this elegant city. Spend the night in a boutique riad.

itinerary.title: Rabat to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Head to Casablanca, Morocco’s largest city. Visit the stunning Hassan II Mosque, an architectural masterpiece overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. Explore the city’s modern districts and enjoy an overnight stay in a comfortable hotel.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Begin your journey to Marrakech, the vibrant "Red City." Check into your riad and spend the afternoon exploring Jemaa el-Fnaa square and its lively atmosphere. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Moroccan dinner.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Marrakech Exploration
itinerary.body: Conclude your journey with a full day in Marrakech. Visit iconic landmarks such as the Koutoubia Mosque, Bahia Palace, and Saadian Tombs. Wander through the colorful souks and relax in the tranquil Majorelle Garden. Transfer to the airport or extend your stay in Marrakech.

title: Marrakech and High Atlas Luxury Escape

itinerary.title: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Arrive in Marrakech and transfer to a luxurious riad in the heart of the Medina. Spend the evening exploring Jemaa el-Fnaa square, where you can enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of street performers, musicians, and food stalls. Dine at a fine-dining Moroccan restaurant to begin your journey with a taste of traditional flavors.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Immerse yourself in Marrakech’s cultural and historical highlights. Visit the Bahia Palace, where intricate mosaics and tranquil courtyards await. Explore the Majorelle Garden, a peaceful retreat surrounded by lush plants and vibrant cobalt blue architecture. After lunch, enjoy a private shopping tour of the souks, guided by an expert to help you discover hidden treasures. Relax with a hammam and spa treatment in the evening, followed by dinner at a rooftop restaurant.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to the High Atlas Mountains
itinerary.body: Travel to the High Atlas Mountains, where the scenery transforms into a landscape of rugged peaks and lush valleys. Check into a luxury lodge in Imlil, a picturesque village at the base of Mount Toubkal. Enjoy a guided hike through the surrounding trails, visiting Berber villages and learning about their way of life. End your day with a farm-to-table dinner featuring local ingredients.

itinerary.title: Explore the High Atlas Mountains
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring the stunning landscapes of the High Atlas. Embark on a longer guided trek to the Toubkal National Park or relax with activities like horseback riding or cycling. Visit a local Berber market and enjoy a traditional tea ceremony in a family home. Return to your lodge for a relaxing evening by the fire.

itinerary.title: High Atlas Mountains to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Return to Marrakech, stopping at Anima Garden, a beautiful botanical garden with art installations by Austrian artist André Heller. Once back in Marrakech, enjoy free time to revisit your favorite parts of the Medina or relax at your riad. Dine at one of Marrakech’s top-rated restaurants, experiencing a fusion of Moroccan and international cuisines.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Use this day to explore at your own pace. Consider a hot air balloon ride over the Palmeraie at sunrise or take a cooking class to master Moroccan dishes like tagine and pastilla. In the evening, enjoy a live performance at the Theatre Royal or attend a private dinner with traditional entertainment.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: After breakfast, transfer to the airport. Leave with unforgettable memories of Marrakech’s vibrant culture and the serene beauty of the High Atlas Mountains.

source: Marrakech/Marrakech and High Atlas Luxury Escape (7 Days, 6 Nights).docx

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.body: Begin your family adventure with a warm welcome at Casablanca’s airport. Transfer to your hotel to settle in before heading out to explore the city. Start at the awe-inspiring Hassan II Mosque, where children and adults alike will marvel at its grand design and oceanfront location. Take a leisurely stroll along the Ain Diab Corniche, a lively waterfront promenade with playgrounds and cafes perfect for families. Conclude your day with a relaxed dinner at a family-friendly restaurant, enjoying Moroccan classics and kid-approved dishes.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Fez via Ifrane
itinerary.body: Set out for Fez, with a scenic stop in Ifrane, Morocco’s “Little Switzerland.” Enjoy a picnic in the cedar forests, where kids will delight in spotting playful Barbary macaques. Continue to Fez, arriving by evening to check into a spacious riad designed for family comfort. Share a light meal and unwind in preparation for the next day’s adventures.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Fez
itinerary.body: Dive into Fez’s vibrant Medina with a family-friendly twist. Embark on a scavenger hunt through the labyrinth of streets, souks, and artisan workshops. Visit the tanneries and Al-Qarawiyyin University while engaging children with interactive storytelling about the city’s history. Enjoy a hands-on pottery demonstration where kids can create their own pieces. After a local lunch, take part in a Moroccan cooking class tailored for families, preparing traditional dishes like mini tagines and sweet Moroccan pastries.

itinerary.title: Fez to Merzouga (Sahara Desert)
itinerary.body: Journey south toward the Sahara Desert, stopping in Midelt for a family-style lunch amidst scenic mountain landscapes. As you approach Merzouga, the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi come into view. Begin your desert adventure with a camel trek to a luxury camp, where your family will be welcomed with mint tea. Spend the evening around the campfire enjoying storytelling, traditional Berber music, and the magic of stargazing in the unpolluted desert sky.

itinerary.title: Merzouga to Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: Wake up early to watch a breathtaking desert sunrise before a hearty breakfast at the camp. Travel to Ouarzazate, stopping at the dramatic Todra Gorge for a short family-friendly hike. Continue through the picturesque Dades Valley, where children will marvel at its unique rock formations. Arrive in Ouarzazate, the “Gateway to the Sahara,” and relax at a comfortable hotel equipped with a pool for the kids.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Head to Marrakech, stopping at Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site and an iconic filming location. Explore the ancient kasbah, allowing kids to imagine life in a historic fortress. Arrive in Marrakech by late afternoon and settle into your riad. Spend the evening at leisure, with the option of a family outing to Jemaa el-Fnaa square to enjoy the vibrant performances and food stalls.

itinerary.title: Return to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Depart Marrakech for Casablanca, with an optional stop at Morocco Mall for some last-minute shopping and family entertainment. Celebrate the end of your journey with a family-style farewell dinner overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. Reflect on the incredible memories made during this enriching Moroccan adventure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.body: Your journey begins with your arrival in Casablanca, Morocco’s economic hub and largest city. After a warm welcome at the airport, enjoy a private transfer to your hotel. Once settled, embark on a guided tour of the city's highlights. Visit the awe-inspiring Hassan II Mosque, perched on the edge of the Atlantic Ocean, where intricate craftsmanship blends with modern engineering. Next, stroll along the Corniche, a vibrant waterfront promenade lined with cafes and restaurants. Immerse yourself in the city’s Art Deco charm as you explore Mohammed V Square and the Habous Quarter. End your day with a traditional Moroccan dinner at the iconic Rick’s Café, evoking the nostalgia of the famous movie Casablanca.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Rabat
itinerary.body: Depart Casablanca in the morning for Rabat, Morocco’s capital and one of its four imperial cities. Begin your exploration at the Royal Palace, a symbol of the monarchy’s modern influence. Next, wander through the Oudayas Kasbah, a historic fortress with narrow blue-and-white streets overlooking the Bouregreg River. The Hassan Tower, an incomplete minaret dating back to the 12th century, and the Mausoleum of Mohammed V are must-sees, showcasing Morocco’s Islamic heritage. Enjoy a leisurely lunch in a riverside café before a relaxed evening to explore Rabat’s Medina at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Rabat to Meknes and Volubilis
itinerary.body: Journey inland to Meknes, where you’ll step into the grandeur of this imperial city. Visit the monumental Bab Mansour, an intricately designed gateway that reflects Morocco’s architectural prowess. Explore the Royal Stables and the Granaries, marveling at the ingenuity of their design. Afterward, continue to Volubilis, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Roam the remarkably preserved Roman ruins, where mosaics and columns tell stories of ancient civilization. End your day in Fez, where you’ll check into a traditional riad in the heart of the Medina.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Fez
itinerary.body: Fez, Morocco’s spiritual and cultural capital, awaits. Spend the day exploring the UNESCO-listed Fez el-Bali Medina, the world’s largest car-free urban area. Wander through its winding streets, visiting landmarks such as the Al-Qarawiyyin University, the Bou Inania Madrasa, and the famed tanneries. Meet artisans in their workshops, crafting pottery, leather goods, and textiles using centuries-old techniques. Pause for lunch in a hidden courtyard before continuing to the Mellah, the historic Jewish Quarter. Cap off your day with a rooftop dinner overlooking the Medina’s twinkling lights.

itinerary.title: Fez to Marrakech via the Middle Atlas
itinerary.body: Travel south through the scenic Middle Atlas Mountains, with a stop in Ifrane, a charming town often called "Little Switzerland" for its alpine-style architecture. Stretch your legs in the cedar forests of Azrou, home to Barbary macaques. Enjoy lunch in Midelt before continuing your journey past rolling landscapes and Berber villages. Arrive in Marrakech by evening, where you’ll check into a luxurious riad in the heart of the Medina. Relax with a cup of mint tea before an optional evening stroll through Jemaa el-Fnaa square.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Dive into Marrakech’s vibrant culture with a full-day tour. Begin with a visit to the Majorelle Garden, a lush oasis once owned by Yves Saint Laurent. Continue to the Bahia Palace, a masterpiece of Moroccan architecture. After lunch in a local eatery, explore the Koutoubia Mosque and its surrounding gardens. In the afternoon, wander through the bustling souks, filled with colorful goods and intoxicating aromas. End your day in Jemaa el-Fnaa square, where performers, food stalls, and storytellers create an enchanting atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Return to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Bid farewell to Marrakech as you head back to Casablanca. Along the way, stop at a charming roadside café for a final taste of Moroccan mint tea. Once in Casablanca, enjoy free time for last-minute shopping or a visit to the Morocco Mall. Conclude your journey with a farewell dinner by the ocean, reminiscing about your incredible Moroccan adventure.

title: Marrakech and Desert Explorer

itinerary.title: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Welcome to the enchanting city of Marrakech, where your adventure begins. Upon arrival at the airport, you’ll be greeted by your guide and transferred to a beautifully restored riad in the Medina. After settling in, take an evening stroll to Jemaa el-Fnaa square, where the city comes alive with storytellers, musicians, and bustling food stalls. Savor your first Moroccan meal under the stars, indulging in delicacies like spiced lamb tagine or chicken pastilla. As the day winds down, relax on your riad’s terrace, soaking in the vibrant atmosphere of the city.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Immerse yourself in Marrakech’s rich history and vibrant culture with a full-day guided tour. Start at the Bahia Palace, a stunning example of Moroccan architecture featuring intricate mosaics and serene courtyards. Continue to the Saadian Tombs, hidden for centuries and now a testament to the grandeur of Morocco’s past. Visit the Koutoubia Mosque, an iconic landmark of the city. After a delicious lunch in a traditional courtyard café, dive into the bustling souks, where you can shop for handwoven carpets, spices, and ceramics. End your day with a rejuvenating hammam experience, followed by a rooftop dinner overlooking the illuminated Medina.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Ait Ben Haddou and Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: Leave Marrakech behind as you journey through the High Atlas Mountains, crossing the Tizi n’Tichka pass with its dramatic landscapes and panoramic views. Arrive at Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site and an iconic kasbah that has served as the backdrop for many films. Take a guided tour of this historic site, exploring its mud-brick buildings and rich history. Continue to Ouarzazate, known as the "Gateway to the Sahara." Visit the Atlas Film Studios to learn about its cinematic legacy and tour the Kasbah Taourirt, a fortress steeped in history. Check into a charming hotel for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Dades Valley and Todra Gorge
itinerary.body: Begin your day with a scenic drive through the Dades Valley, often called the “Valley of a Thousand Kasbahs” for its numerous fortified villages. Stop for a short hike amidst the dramatic landscapes of the Todra Gorge, where sheer cliffs rise over 300 meters high, creating a breathtaking natural setting. Along the way, visit local Berber villages and learn about their customs and traditions. Arrive at a cozy guesthouse in the valley, where you’ll be treated to a home-cooked Moroccan dinner and the warm hospitality of your hosts.

itinerary.title: Todra Gorge to Merzouga (Sahara Desert)
itinerary.body: Continue your journey to the Sahara Desert, where the landscape transforms into an expanse of golden dunes. Upon arriving in Merzouga, embark on a camel trek into the mesmerizing Erg Chebbi dunes. Your destination is a luxury desert camp, where you’ll be welcomed with traditional mint tea. As the sun sets, enjoy a lavish Moroccan dinner under the stars, followed by an evening of Berber music and storytelling around a campfire. The serene desert setting offers a magical atmosphere for an unforgettable night.

itinerary.title: Full Day in the Sahara Desert
itinerary.body: Awake early to witness the beauty of a desert sunrise, painting the dunes in shades of gold and crimson. After breakfast, visit a nearby nomadic village to learn about the unique traditions and lifestyle of the desert communities. Spend your day immersed in the desert’s beauty, trying activities like sandboarding or quad biking. Enjoy lunch back at the camp and relax in the tranquil surroundings. As night falls, gather around the fire for another evening of stargazing, where the unpolluted desert skies reveal a dazzling display of constellations.

itinerary.title: Return to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Bid farewell to the Sahara as you begin your journey back to Marrakech. Stop along the way at scenic viewpoints and charming villages to capture the beauty of the High Atlas Mountains. Pause for lunch in Ouarzazate or a quaint roadside café. Arrive in Marrakech by evening and conclude your journey with a farewell dinner. Celebrate your adventure with live Moroccan music and a feast of local specialties in a lively yet intimate setting.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at your riad, reflecting on the incredible journey you’ve experienced. Transfer to the airport for your departure, carrying cherished memories of Marrakech’s vibrant culture, the dramatic landscapes of the desert, and the warm hospitality of Morocco’s people.

source: Marrakech/Marrakech and Desert Explorer (8 Days, 7 Nights).docx

title: Sahara and Atlas Adventure

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Begin your journey with a scenic drive from Casablanca to Marrakech. After checking into your riad, take a guided evening tour of Jemaa el-Fnaa square, experiencing the lively street performers, storytellers, and aromatic food stalls. Enjoy dinner at a local restaurant serving traditional Moroccan cuisine.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: Leave Marrakech in the morning and head toward Ouarzazate, crossing the majestic High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi n’Tichka pass. Along the way, stop at the famous Ait Ben Haddou Kasbah, a UNESCO World Heritage site that has been featured in numerous films. Arrive in Ouarzazate, known as the "Gateway to the Sahara," and visit the Atlas Film Studios. Spend the evening relaxing in your hotel.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Dades Valley
itinerary.body: Travel to the breathtaking Dades Valley, often referred to as the “Valley of a Thousand Kasbahs.” En route, stop at Skoura to explore its ancient palm groves. Take a short hike through the dramatic landscapes of the Dades Gorges, where towering rock formations create a stunning backdrop. Check into your guesthouse and enjoy a home-cooked Moroccan meal.

itinerary.title: Dades Valley to Merzouga (Sahara Desert)
itinerary.body: Continue your journey toward the Sahara Desert, passing through the Todra Gorges, a spectacular canyon carved by the Todra River. Arrive in Merzouga, where you’ll ride camels across the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi to reach your luxury desert camp. Spend the evening under the stars, enjoying traditional music and a delicious Moroccan feast.

itinerary.title: Full Day in the Sahara Desert
itinerary.body: Immerse yourself in the beauty of the Sahara with a day full of activities. Begin with a sunrise camel ride over the dunes, followed by breakfast at the camp. Visit a nearby nomadic village to learn about desert life and local traditions. After lunch, try sandboarding or quad biking on the dunes. Enjoy another magical evening around the campfire, sharing stories under the vast desert sky.

itinerary.title: Sahara to Fez
itinerary.body: Leave the desert behind as you travel north to Fez. Along the way, stop in Midelt for lunch and admire the scenic landscapes of the Ziz Valley and cedar forests of the Middle Atlas Mountains. Arrive in Fez by evening and settle into your riad.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Fez
itinerary.body: Explore the ancient city of Fez, starting with a guided tour of the Medina, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Visit the Al-Qarawiyyin University, the tanneries, and artisan workshops. Pause for lunch in a hidden courtyard restaurant before exploring the Mellah (Jewish Quarter) and the Royal Palace. End your day with a relaxing rooftop dinner overlooking the city.

itinerary.title: Return to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Conclude your adventure with a return journey to Casablanca. Use the day for last-minute sightseeing or shopping before a farewell dinner by the ocean.

source: Casa/Sahara and Atlas Adventure (8 Days, 7 Nights).docx

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.body: Arrive in Casablanca, where your guide will welcome you and transfer you to your hotel. Begin your journey with a visit to the iconic Hassan II Mosque, one of the largest mosques in the world, offering stunning oceanfront views. Explore the Habous Quarter, known for its blend of traditional and French colonial architecture. In the evening, enjoy a relaxed dinner at a seaside restaurant, sampling fresh seafood and classic Moroccan dishes.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Travel south to Marrakech, the vibrant "Red City." After checking into your riad, set out to explore Jemaa el-Fnaa square, where musicians, snake charmers, and storytellers create an unforgettable atmosphere. Visit the nearby Koutoubia Mosque, a landmark of Islamic architecture, before enjoying a rooftop dinner overlooking the bustling Medina.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Discover Marrakech’s highlights with a full-day guided tour. Begin at the Majorelle Garden, a tranquil haven of exotic plants and cobalt blue structures. Visit the Bahia Palace, known for its stunning mosaics and elegant courtyards. After lunch, explore the colorful souks, where artisans sell spices, leather goods, and jewelry. Conclude your day with a traditional Moroccan hammam experience, followed by dinner at a fine dining restaurant.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Agadir
itinerary.body: Depart for Agadir, a coastal gem famous for its golden beaches and modern vibe. Check into a beachfront hotel and spend the afternoon relaxing by the sea or strolling along the marina. Visit the Kasbah of Agadir Oufella for panoramic views of the city and the Atlantic Ocean. Enjoy dinner at a local seafood restaurant, featuring freshly caught fish and regional specialties.

itinerary.title: Agadir to Taroudant
itinerary.body: Travel to Taroudant, a charming fortified town often called "Little Marrakech." Explore the city’s ancient walls, bustling souks, and traditional Berber markets. Visit the Taliouine Saffron Cooperative to learn about saffron farming in the region. Spend the night in a cozy guesthouse surrounded by lush orchards and gardens.

itinerary.title: Taroudant to Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: Journey through the High Atlas Mountains to Ouarzazate, the gateway to the Sahara Desert. Along the way, stop at the Taznakht cooperative, famous for its handmade Berber rugs. Visit Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and explore its well-preserved kasbahs. In Ouarzazate, enjoy a guided tour of the Atlas Film Studios before settling into your hotel for the evening.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Return to Marrakech, with scenic stops along the way to appreciate the dramatic landscapes of the Atlas Mountains. Once back in Marrakech, enjoy free time to revisit the souks, relax at your riad, or explore new corners of the Medina. Celebrate your journey with a farewell dinner at a traditional Moroccan restaurant.

itinerary.title: Return to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Conclude your tour with a return trip to Casablanca. Spend your final hours exploring Morocco Mall or the Corniche before transferring to the airport for your departure.

title: The Authentic Morocco Tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.body: Arrive in Casablanca, where you’ll be greeted at the airport and transferred to your hotel. Begin your Moroccan adventure with a tour of the Hassan II Mosque, an architectural masterpiece set on the edge of the Atlantic Ocean. Continue to the Habous Quarter, known for its quaint streets and artisan shops. Take a stroll along the bustling Corniche, where the ocean breeze complements the vibrant atmosphere. End your day with dinner at the iconic Rick’s Café, where the ambiance will transport you to the classic film Casablanca.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Chefchaouen
itinerary.body: Depart Casablanca and journey to the enchanting blue city of Chefchaouen. Nestled in the Rif Mountains, Chefchaouen is famed for its blue-painted streets and relaxed charm. After checking into your riad, spend the afternoon wandering through the Medina’s narrow alleys, taking in the vibrant shades of blue and white. Visit the Kasbah Museum for a glimpse into the town’s history. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Moroccan meal at a cozy local restaurant.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Chefchaouen
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring Chefchaouen’s hidden gems. Visit the Spanish Mosque, located on a hilltop just outside the town, for breathtaking panoramic views of the blue Medina and surrounding mountains. Stroll through local artisan shops that showcase handmade woolen garments, leather goods, and intricate jewelry. Relax at a café in the main square, sipping Moroccan mint tea as you soak in the peaceful ambiance. For nature lovers, consider a short hike to the nearby Ras El Maa waterfall.

itinerary.title: Chefchaouen to Fez
itinerary.body: Travel south from Chefchaouen to Fez, with a stop at the historic town of Ouazzane, a spiritual center known for its olive groves and serene atmosphere. Arrive in Fez by late afternoon and check into your riad. Spend the evening exploring the city’s vibrant souks or relaxing at your riad with a traditional Moroccan dinner.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Fez
itinerary.body: Dive deep into the ancient city of Fez, Morocco’s cultural and spiritual capital. Begin your guided tour in the Medina, Fez el-Bali, the world’s largest car-free urban area. Visit landmarks such as the Al-Qarawiyyin University, the Bou Inania Madrasa, and the tanneries. Meet artisans crafting pottery, brassware, and leather goods using time-honored techniques. Enjoy lunch at a hidden gem within the Medina before continuing to the Mellah (Jewish Quarter) and the Royal Palace.

itinerary.title: Fez to Rabat
itinerary.body: Depart Fez and journey to Rabat, Morocco’s modern capital. Upon arrival, explore the city’s historic sites, including the Hassan Tower, the Mausoleum of Mohammed V, and the Oudayas Kasbah. Enjoy a leisurely walk along the Bouregreg River, where the calm waters and surrounding greenery create a tranquil escape. Spend the evening dining at a riverside restaurant before settling into your hotel.

itinerary.title: Rabat to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Head back to Casablanca, with an optional stop in Mohammedia, a charming coastal town. Once in Casablanca, enjoy free time to explore the Morocco Mall, stroll along the Ain Diab Corniche, or revisit favorite sites. End your day with a farewell dinner by the ocean, celebrating your incredible journey through Morocco.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure. Take home unforgettable memories of Morocco’s diverse landscapes, rich culture, and warm hospitality.

source: Casa/The Authentic Morocco Tour (8 Days, 7 Nights).docx

title: Grand Marrakech to Sahara Odyssey

itinerary.title: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Welcome to Marrakech! Upon arrival, your private guide will greet you and escort you to a beautifully restored riad in the heart of the Medina. Take time to relax and soak in the ambiance of Moroccan hospitality. As evening falls, head to Jemaa el-Fnaa square, where a lively mix of musicians, storytellers, and street performers fills the air with energy. Sample authentic street food like harira soup, spiced kebabs, or msemen pancakes. Stroll through the illuminated square and enjoy your first glimpse of Marrakech’s vibrant culture before returning to your riad for the night.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Immerse yourself in the history and culture of Marrakech with a guided tour of its most iconic landmarks. Begin at the Bahia Palace, a 19th-century masterpiece of intricate carvings and tranquil courtyards. Continue to the Saadian Tombs, hidden for centuries and now restored to showcase their ornate design. Visit the Koutoubia Mosque, the city’s spiritual heart and an enduring symbol of Marrakech. After a traditional Moroccan lunch, dive into the colorful souks, where your guide will help you discover unique crafts such as leather goods, pottery, and spices. Conclude your day with a luxurious hammam experience, leaving you refreshed and ready for the journey ahead.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Ouarzazate via Ait Ben Haddou
itinerary.body: Set out on a scenic drive across the High Atlas Mountains, winding through the dramatic Tizi n’Tichka pass. Pause at panoramic viewpoints to admire the rugged beauty of the peaks and valleys. Arrive at Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site and a well-preserved kasbah used as a filming location for numerous movies. Explore its ancient streets and learn about its historical significance. Continue to Ouarzazate, known as the "Gateway to the Sahara." Visit the Atlas Film Studios to discover its cinematic legacy before settling into a comfortable hotel for the evening.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Dades Valley
itinerary.body: Begin your day with a journey through the "Road of a Thousand Kasbahs," a region dotted with traditional Berber fortresses. Reach the Dades Valley, where stunning rock formations and lush landscapes create a striking contrast. Take a guided walk through the Dades Gorges, marveling at the towering red cliffs. Visit a nearby Berber village to learn about local customs and enjoy mint tea with a family. End your day with a hearty home-cooked dinner at a charming guesthouse nestled in the valley.

itinerary.title: Dades Valley to Merzouga (Sahara Desert)
itinerary.body: Continue your journey toward the Sahara Desert, stopping at Todra Gorge for a scenic hike along its dramatic canyon walls. As you approach Merzouga, the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi come into view. Embark on a camel trek through the dunes, guided by experienced local camel handlers. Arrive at a luxury desert camp, where you’ll be welcomed with traditional mint tea. Enjoy a gourmet dinner under a canopy of stars, followed by an evening of Berber music and storytelling around the campfire.

itinerary.title: Full Day in the Sahara Desert
itinerary.body: Rise early to witness a breathtaking desert sunrise, painting the dunes in shades of gold and crimson. After breakfast, embark on a day of discovery in the Sahara. Visit a nearby nomadic tribe to learn about their traditions and lifestyle. For adventurers, try sandboarding down the dunes or quad biking across the vast expanse. Enjoy lunch at a kasbah in the nearby village, where you’ll savor authentic Berber dishes. Return to the camp for a relaxed afternoon of unwinding in the serene desert setting. As night falls, gather around the campfire for stargazing under the unpolluted desert skies, a truly magical experience.

itinerary.title: Sahara to Agdz and Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: Depart the Sahara and travel to the peaceful town of Agdz, located in the lush Draa Valley. Explore palm groves, ancient kasbahs, and the charming market square. Continue to Ouarzazate, where you’ll check into a boutique hotel and enjoy the evening at your leisure. Relax by the pool, take a stroll through the town, or enjoy a quiet dinner in a local restaurant.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Begin your return journey to Marrakech, stopping at scenic viewpoints and charming villages along the way. Arrive in Marrakech by late afternoon, giving you time to revisit the souks, indulge in a spa treatment, or simply relax at your riad. Celebrate your incredible adventure with a farewell rooftop dinner, accompanied by live Moroccan music and traditional dishes.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before your private transfer to the airport. Reflect on the unforgettable experiences of Marrakech, the dramatic landscapes of the Sahara, and the warm hospitality of Morocco’s people as you depart for your next destination.

source: Marrakech/Grand Marrakech to Sahara Odyssey (9 Days, 8 Nights).docx

title: The Royal Road Tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.body: Arrive in Casablanca and enjoy a private transfer to your hotel. Begin your tour with a visit to the majestic Hassan II Mosque, followed by a leisurely walk along the vibrant Corniche. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Moroccan dinner while overlooking the Atlantic Ocean.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Rabat and Meknes
itinerary.body: Depart Casablanca and head to Rabat, where you’ll explore key landmarks like the Oudayas Kasbah, the Hassan Tower, and the Mausoleum of Mohammed V. After lunch, continue to Meknes, an imperial city steeped in history. Visit Bab Mansour, the Royal Granaries, and the Medina before settling into a riad for the night.

itinerary.title: Meknes to Fez via Volubilis
itinerary.body: Begin your day with a visit to Volubilis, a stunning Roman archaeological site. Take a guided tour to admire its well-preserved mosaics and ancient columns. Continue to Fez, where you’ll enjoy a relaxing evening in a charming riad.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Fez
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring Fez’s historic Medina. Visit Al-Qarawiyyin University, artisan workshops, and the vibrant souks. Pause for lunch at a local eatery before visiting the Mellah and the Royal Palace. End your day with a scenic rooftop dinner overlooking the Medina.

itinerary.title: Fez to the Sahara Desert
itinerary.body: Journey through the Middle Atlas Mountains, stopping at Ifrane and Azrou. Arrive in Merzouga and embark on a camel trek into the Sahara Desert. Spend the night in a luxury desert camp under the stars.

itinerary.title: Sahara to Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: Leave the dunes behind and travel to Ouarzazate, the gateway to the Sahara. Stop at the Todra Gorge and the Dades Valley along the way. Arrive in Ouarzazate by evening, where you’ll unwind in a comfortable hotel.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Cross the High Atlas Mountains as you journey to Marrakech. Stop at the UNESCO-listed Ait Ben Haddou Kasbah, a historic fortress often featured in films. Arrive in Marrakech by late afternoon and settle into your riad.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Explore Marrakech’s cultural highlights, including the Majorelle Garden, Bahia Palace, and Koutoubia Mosque. Spend the afternoon wandering through the colorful souks and conclude your day with an authentic hammam experience.

itinerary.title: Return to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Return to Casablanca, stopping for a scenic lunch along the way. Spend your final evening enjoying a farewell dinner by the ocean.

source: Casa/The Royal Road Tour (9 Days, 8 Nights).docx

title: Ultimate Desert and Atlas Expedition
subtitle: Fez to Marrakech
intro: Embark on an extraordinary 9-day journey that showcases the best of Morocco’s desert landscapes, vibrant cities, and cultural treasures. This extended adventure takes you from Fez through the Sahara Desert, the Atlas Mountains, and hidden Berber villages, culminating in the lively streets of Marrakech. Perfect for those seeking a deeper connection with Morocco’s diverse heritage.

itinerary.title: Fez to Ifrane and Midelt
itinerary.body: Your journey begins with a scenic drive through the Middle Atlas Mountains. Stop in Ifrane, Morocco’s "Little Switzerland," and the cedar forests of Azrou, where Barbary macaques roam. Continue to Midelt for a traditional Moroccan lunch and spend your first night in a charming hotel surrounded by mountain views.

itinerary.title: Midelt to Erfoud and Merzouga
itinerary.body: Travel south through the breathtaking Ziz Valley, known for its lush palm groves and ancient kasbahs. Arrive in Erfoud, famous for its fossil workshops, before continuing to Merzouga. Enjoy a relaxing evening in a traditional riad near the desert.

itinerary.title: Merzouga and Camel Trekking
itinerary.body: Explore the villages around Merzouga, including Khamlia, known for its Gnaoua music. Visit nomadic Berber communities and learn about their lifestyle. In the afternoon, embark on a camel trek into the dunes of Erg Chebbi. Arrive at a luxury desert camp for a magical night under the stars.

itinerary.title: Merzouga to Todra Gorge
itinerary.body: Witness the sunrise over the dunes before returning to Merzouga by camel. After breakfast, travel to the Todra Gorge, a spectacular canyon with towering cliffs. Enjoy a leisurely walk along the river and spend the night in a cozy riad near the gorge.

itinerary.title: Todra Gorge to Dades Valley
itinerary.body: Journey through the stunning Dades Valley, stopping at the "Monkey Fingers" rock formations and ancient kasbahs. Take a guided walk to discover the valley’s unique geological features and Berber villages. Relax in a picturesque riad overlooking the valley.

itinerary.title: Dades Valley to Skoura and Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: Continue through the scenic Rose Valley, famous for its fragrant rose products and annual festival. Visit Skoura’s Amridil Kasbah and enjoy lunch in a local Berber village. Arrive in Ouarzazate, where you can explore the Atlas Film Studios or the Taourirt Kasbah. Spend the night in a traditional riad.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Aït Benhaddou
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring the UNESCO World Heritage site of Aït Benhaddou, a fortified village that has served as the backdrop for many famous films. Take a guided tour to learn about its history and architecture. Relax in a nearby riad for the night.

itinerary.title: Aït Benhaddou to Marrakech via High Atlas Mountains
itinerary.body: Cross the High Atlas Mountains, traveling along the scenic Tizi n'Tichka Pass. Stop at traditional Berber villages and enjoy breathtaking views. Arrive in Marrakech by late afternoon and check into your accommodation.

itinerary.title: Explore Marrakech
itinerary.body: Conclude your adventure with a full day to explore Marrakech’s vibrant culture and historic landmarks. Visit the Koutoubia Mosque, Bahia Palace, and the bustling souks of the Medina. Take in the lively atmosphere of Jemaa el-Fnaa square before ending your journey.

title: Imperial Cities Tour
subtitle: Journey Through Morocco’s Historic Capitals from Fez
intro: Embark on an incredible journey through Morocco’s imperial cities, starting from the cultural heart of Fez. This 10-day tour takes you through the vibrant streets of Marrakech, the ancient grandeur of Meknes, and the modern charm of Rabat. Explore UNESCO World Heritage sites, lively medinas, and majestic palaces as you uncover the history and culture of Morocco’s historic capitals.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Fez
itinerary.body: Arrive in Fez and settle into your riad. Spend the evening relaxing or taking a short walk through the Medina to familiarize yourself with this historic city.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Fez Exploration
itinerary.body: Dive into Fez’s cultural and historical wonders. Visit the Al-Qarawiyyin Mosque, Bou Inania Madrasa, the vibrant souks, and the traditional tanneries. Learn about Fez’s significance as Morocco’s spiritual and cultural heart.

itinerary.title: Fez to Meknes
itinerary.body: Travel to Meknes, one of Morocco’s imperial cities. Explore its monumental gates, the Royal Stables, and the Moulay Ismail Mausoleum. Spend the night in a charming riad in Meknes.

itinerary.title: Meknes and Volubilis
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring the nearby Roman ruins of Volubilis, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Wander through the ancient city’s mosaics and ruins before returning to Meknes for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Meknes to Rabat
itinerary.body: Journey to Rabat, Morocco’s modern capital. Explore the Royal Palace, Hassan Tower, and the tranquil Oudayas Kasbah. Stroll along the city’s coastal promenade before spending the night in a boutique riad.

itinerary.title: Rabat to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Travel to Casablanca, Morocco’s largest city. Visit the stunning Hassan II Mosque, one of the largest mosques in the world. Enjoy a leisurely evening in this cosmopolitan city.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Begin your journey to Marrakech, the vibrant "Red City." Check into your riad and spend the evening at leisure, soaking in the lively atmosphere of Jemaa el-Fnaa square.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Marrakech Exploration
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring Marrakech’s iconic landmarks. Visit the Koutoubia Mosque, Bahia Palace, and Saadian Tombs. Stroll through the vibrant Medina and immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of Jemaa el-Fnaa square.

itinerary.title: Majorelle Garden and Free Time in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Visit the beautiful Majorelle Garden, a tranquil oasis filled with exotic plants and vibrant colors. Enjoy free time to shop in the souks or relax in a traditional hammam.

itinerary.title: Departure from Marrakech
itinerary.body: Conclude your journey with a transfer to Marrakech Menara Airport. Take home memories of Morocco’s imperial cities and their timeless beauty.

title: Moroccan Desert and Mountains Adventure

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.body: Begin your Moroccan adventure with a guided tour of Casablanca, the country’s largest city and economic hub. Visit the iconic Hassan II Mosque, a masterpiece of modern Islamic architecture perched on the Atlantic Ocean. Explore the Habous Quarter, known for its French-Moroccan charm and artisan markets. End your day with a delightful dinner overlooking the ocean before retiring to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Journey to the vibrant city of Marrakech, where history and modernity blend seamlessly. Spend the afternoon exploring the Medina, discovering colorful souks, and visiting landmarks like the Koutoubia Mosque. Relax at your riad, then enjoy a rooftop dinner with stunning views of the city as the sun sets over the Red City.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Ouarzazate
itinerary.body: Travel through the majestic High Atlas Mountains, crossing the Tizi n’Tichka pass. Stop at the UNESCO-listed Ait Ben Haddou Kasbah, an ancient fortified village and popular filming location. Continue to Ouarzazate, known as the “Gateway to the Sahara,” where you’ll visit the Atlas Film Studios and the historic Kasbah Taourirt. Settle into your hotel for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Merzouga (Sahara Desert)
itinerary.body: Venture deeper into southern Morocco, passing through the picturesque Dades Valley and the dramatic Todra Gorges. Stop for a scenic hike amidst the towering canyon walls. Arrive in Merzouga, where you’ll embark on a camel trek into the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi. Spend the night in a luxury desert camp, enjoying a starlit dinner and traditional Berber music around the campfire.

itinerary.title: Full Day in the Sahara Desert
itinerary.body: Wake up early to witness a breathtaking sunrise over the dunes. Spend the day immersing yourself in desert life—visit a nomadic village to learn about their unique culture, try sandboarding on the dunes, or take a thrilling 4x4 excursion. Relax at the camp in the afternoon before another magical evening of storytelling and stargazing under the vast desert skies.

itinerary.title: Sahara to Midelt
itinerary.body: Bid farewell to the Sahara and journey through the lush Ziz Valley, passing through scenic palm groves and Berber villages. Arrive in Midelt, a tranquil town nestled in the Middle Atlas Mountains, where you’ll enjoy a cozy evening in a welcoming guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Midelt to Fez
itinerary.body: Continue your journey to Fez, stopping at the cedar forests near Azrou to see the playful Barbary macaques. Arrive in Fez, Morocco’s spiritual and cultural capital, and unwind in a charming riad. In the evening, savor a delicious Moroccan dinner in the Medina.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Fez
itinerary.body: Immerse yourself in the history and culture of Fez, starting with a guided tour of its UNESCO-listed Medina, the world’s largest car-free urban area. Visit landmarks such as the Al-Qarawiyyin University, the Bou Inania Madrasa, and the famous tanneries. Meet local artisans and learn about traditional Moroccan crafts. Enjoy a lavish Moroccan feast at a hidden gem restaurant in the Medina.

itinerary.title: Fez to Chefchaouen
itinerary.body: Travel north to Chefchaouen, the enchanting blue city in the Rif Mountains. Spend the afternoon wandering its serene blue-painted streets, exploring the Kasbah Museum, and relaxing in the town’s peaceful squares. Stay overnight in a charming riad that offers stunning views of the surrounding mountains.

itinerary.title: Chefchaouen to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Conclude your adventure with a scenic drive back to Casablanca. Enjoy free time to shop for souvenirs, visit the Morocco Mall, or take a final stroll along the Corniche. Celebrate your journey with a farewell dinner overlooking the Atlantic Ocean, reminiscing about your incredible experiences in Morocco.

source: Casa/Moroccan Desert and Mountains Tour (10 Days, 9 Nights).docx

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.body: Begin your luxury Moroccan adventure with a private transfer to a five-star hotel in Casablanca. Embark on a guided tour of the iconic Hassan II Mosque, an architectural masterpiece perched on the Atlantic Ocean. Stroll through the charming Habous Quarter, known for its blend of French colonial and traditional Moroccan styles. End your day with a gourmet dinner at Rick’s Café, where live music and elegant décor evoke the romance of classic Casablanca.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Fez via Rabat
itinerary.body: Travel in a private luxury vehicle to Fez, stopping in Rabat, Morocco’s capital. Enjoy a personalized tour of the Oudayas Kasbah, with its stunning blue-and-white streets, and visit the Mausoleum of Mohammed V. Continue to Fez, where you’ll check into a luxurious riad offering world-class service and breathtaking views of the Medina.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Fez
itinerary.body: Explore the ancient city of Fez with a private guide, diving into the labyrinthine streets of the UNESCO-listed Medina.
