Visit the Al-Qarawiyyin University, artisan workshops, and the Mellah (Jewish Quarter). Gain exclusive access to hidden courtyards and rooftops for unique perspectives of this historic city. Conclude your day with an exquisite dinner at one of Fez’s finest restaurants.

itinerary.title: Fez to Merzouga (Sahara Desert)
itinerary.body: Depart Fez in a private 4x4 vehicle, traveling through the scenic Middle Atlas Mountains and picturesque Berber villages. Arrive in Merzouga and embark on a camel trek to your private luxury desert camp nestled in the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi. Dine under the stars with a chef-prepared meal, accompanied by traditional Berber music.

itinerary.title: Full Day in the Sahara Desert
itinerary.body: Immerse yourself in the serenity of the desert with personalized activities. Begin the day with sunrise yoga on the dunes, then visit a nomadic community to learn about their unique way of life. Enjoy adventurous options like quad biking or sandboarding. In the evening, savor another gourmet dinner prepared by a private chef as the desert sky lights up with countless stars.

itinerary.title: Sahara to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Travel through the scenic Dades Valley and High Atlas Mountains, stopping for a private tour of the UNESCO-listed Ait Ben Haddou Kasbah. Arrive in Marrakech and check into a luxurious riad, where a welcome massage will help you unwind. Spend your evening exploring the Medina or relaxing in the comfort of your riad.

itinerary.title: Full Day in Marrakech
itinerary.body: Discover the vibrant culture of Marrakech with a private tour of the Majorelle Garden and Yves Saint Laurent Museum. Visit the Bahia Palace, a stunning example of Moroccan architecture, before embarking on a VIP shopping experience in the bustling souks. Artisans will showcase their finest work exclusively for you. End your day with a fine dining experience, where Moroccan and international cuisines blend seamlessly.

itinerary.title: Marrakech to Essaouira
itinerary.body: Take a private journey to Essaouira, a coastal gem with a laid-back charm. Explore its UNESCO-listed Medina, historic Skala fortress, and artisan markets. Enjoy a seafood lunch by the bustling port before returning to Marrakech for a relaxing evening at your riad.

itinerary.title: Return to Casablanca
itinerary.body: Head back to Casablanca in style, stopping for scenic photo opportunities along the way. Spend your final evening with a farewell dinner overlooking the Atlantic Ocean, reminiscing about the incredible experiences of your journey.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.body: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before your private transfer to the airport. Depart with cherished memories of Morocco’s diverse landscapes, rich culture, and luxurious hospitality.

title: Grand Desert and Cultural Journey
subtitle: Fez to Marrakech
intro: Discover Morocco’s diverse landscapes, ancient cities, and rich culture on this immersive 11-day journey. From the enchanting streets of Fez to the golden dunes of the Sahara Desert and the vibrant markets of Marrakech, this tour offers a perfect balance of adventure, history, and relaxation. Explore hidden villages, historic kasbahs, and majestic mountain ranges while experiencing authentic Moroccan hospitality.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Fez
itinerary.body: Arrive in the imperial city of Fez, known for its historic Medina and vibrant culture. Check into your riad and enjoy a relaxing evening exploring nearby sights or resting after your journey.

itinerary.title: Explore Fez
itinerary.body: Spend the day discovering the wonders of Fez. Visit the UNESCO-listed Medina, explore the Al-Qarawiyyin Mosque and University, and admire the intricate tilework of the Bou Inania Madrasa. End the day with a visit to the tanneries for a glimpse into Morocco’s traditional leather-making process.

itinerary.title: Fez to Midelt via the Middle Atlas Mountains
itinerary.body: Begin your adventure through the Middle Atlas Mountains. Visit Ifrane, the "Little Switzerland" of Morocco, and the cedar forests of Azrou. Continue to Midelt, where you’ll stay in a charming hotel surrounded by mountain views.

itinerary.title: Midelt to Merzouga
itinerary.body: Descend through the Ziz Valley, passing palm groves and ancient kasbahs. Arrive in Merzouga, where you’ll enjoy a relaxing evening in a traditional riad near the desert.

itinerary.title: Merzouga and Camel Trekking
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring the desert landscapes and nearby villages. Visit Khamlia for a performance of Gnaoua music and learn about Berber nomadic culture. In the afternoon, embark on a camel trek into the dunes of Erg Chebbi, arriving at your luxury desert camp for an unforgettable night under the stars.

itinerary.title: Merzouga to Todra Gorge
itinerary.body: Watch the sunrise over the dunes before returning to Merzouga by camel. After breakfast, travel to the Todra Gorge, a stunning canyon with towering cliffs. Enjoy a guided walk along the river and spend the night in a cozy riad near the gorge.

itinerary.title: Todra Gorge to Dades Valley and Skoura
itinerary.body: Journey through the scenic Dades Valley, stopping at the "Monkey Fingers" rock formations and local kasbahs. Continue to Skoura, a picturesque oasis known for its historic Amridil Kasbah. Spend the night in a traditional riad.

itinerary.title: Skoura to Ouarzazate and Aït Benhaddou
itinerary.body: Explore the cinematic city of Ouarzazate, including the Taourirt Kasbah and Atlas Film Studios. Visit the UNESCO-listed Aït Benhaddou, a fortified village with a rich history. Stay overnight in a nearby riad.

itinerary.title: Aït Benhaddou to Taroudant
itinerary.body: Travel through the Souss Valley to the charming town of Taroudant, often referred to as a "mini Marrakech." Explore its bustling souks and well-preserved city walls. Spend the night in a boutique riad.

itinerary.title: Taroudant to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Cross the High Atlas Mountains, traveling along the Tizi n'Tichka Pass. Enjoy scenic stops at Berber villages and panoramic viewpoints. Arrive in Marrakech by late afternoon, where you’ll settle into your accommodation and enjoy an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Explore Marrakech
itinerary.body: Conclude your adventure with a full day in Marrakech. Visit iconic landmarks such as the Koutoubia Mosque, Bahia Palace, and Majorelle Garden. Stroll through the vibrant Medina and experience the lively atmosphere of Jemaa el-Fnaa square before ending your journey.

title: Ultimate Moroccan Desert and Cultural Tour
intro: Explore the very heart of Morocco on this incredible 15-day journey. From the imperial cities of Fez and Marrakech to the vast expanse of the Sahara Desert and the breathtaking High Atlas Mountains, this tour combines natural wonders, historic sites, and authentic cultural experiences for an unforgettable adventure. Perfect for travelers looking to immerse themselves deeply into Morocco’s rich heritage and diverse landscapes.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Fez

itinerary.title: Full-Day Fez Exploration
itinerary.body: Dive into Fez’s cultural and historical wonders. Visit the Al-Qarawiyyin Mosque, Bou Inania Madrasa, the vibrant souks, and the traditional tanneries. Learn about Fez’s significance as Morocco’s spiritual and cultural heart.

itinerary.title: Fez to Chefchaouen
itinerary.body: Take a scenic drive to the blue city of Chefchaouen, nestled in the Rif Mountains. Explore the winding blue-washed streets, vibrant plazas, and artisan shops. Spend the night in a charming riad.

itinerary.title: Chefchaouen to Meknes and Volubilis
itinerary.body: Travel to Meknes, one of Morocco’s imperial cities, and explore its impressive gates and royal stables. Continue to Volubilis, a UNESCO World Heritage site, to wander among the ancient Roman ruins. Overnight in Meknes.

itinerary.title: Meknes to Midelt via Ifrane
itinerary.body: Journey through the Middle Atlas Mountains, stopping in Ifrane, known for its alpine-style charm, and Azrou’s cedar forests. Continue to Midelt for a relaxing evening surrounded by mountain landscapes.

itinerary.title: Midelt to Merzouga
itinerary.body: Descend through the Ziz Valley, famous for its lush palm groves, en route to Merzouga. Enjoy an evening in a desert riad and prepare for your Sahara adventure.

itinerary.title: Merzouga and Camel Trekking
itinerary.body: Spend the morning exploring Merzouga’s surroundings, including Khamlia’s Gnaoua music village. In the afternoon, embark on a camel trek into the dunes of Erg Chebbi. Experience a magical night in a luxury desert camp.

itinerary.title: Merzouga to Todra Gorge
itinerary.body: Watch the sunrise over the dunes before returning to Merzouga by camel. Travel to Todra Gorge to marvel at its towering cliffs and take a peaceful walk along the river. Overnight in a nearby riad.

itinerary.title: Todra Gorge to Dades Valley
itinerary.body: Explore the dramatic landscapes of the Dades Valley. Visit the "Monkey Fingers" rock formations and nearby kasbahs. Spend the night in a traditional riad overlooking the valley.

itinerary.title: Dades Valley to Ouarzazate via Skoura
itinerary.body: Travel through the Rose Valley, famous for its fragrant rose products, and visit Skoura’s iconic Amridil Kasbah. Arrive in Ouarzazate, where you can explore the Atlas Film Studios or Taourirt Kasbah. Overnight in Ouarzazate.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Aït Benhaddou
itinerary.body: Spend the day exploring Aït Benhaddou, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Take a guided tour of the fortified village and learn about its role in Morocco’s history. Stay overnight in a nearby riad.

itinerary.title: Aït Benhaddou to Taroudant
itinerary.body: Travel through the Souss Valley to Taroudant, known for its bustling souks and well-preserved city walls. Enjoy a relaxed evening in this charming town.

itinerary.title: Taroudant to Essaouira
itinerary.body: Drive to Essaouira, a coastal town known for its laid-back vibe, historic medina, and beautiful beaches. Spend the afternoon exploring the port, ramparts, and artisan shops.

itinerary.title: Essaouira to Marrakech
itinerary.body: Journey to Marrakech, where you’ll settle into your accommodation. Spend the evening enjoying the lively atmosphere of Jemaa el-Fnaa square.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Marrakech Exploration
itinerary.body: Conclude your journey with a full day in Marrakech. Visit the Koutoubia Mosque, Bahia Palace, and the Majorelle Garden. Immerse yourself in the vibrant souks and enjoy a farewell dinner in the Medina.
